verdict.rationale: The built-in web UI runs against `llama serve`, the same server you can launch directly, so the UI appears to be a client of the server API. That implies UI actions go through an API a user could also call. However, the pack never documents the API endpoints or explicitly confirms parity with the UI. Missing for 10: documented server API endpoints and their coverage, explicit confirmation that every UI feature is exposed via the API, independent or hands-on corroboration of API-driven use.
